Patch Set 1:

(7 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. The three on-disk LMA encryption checks test dt_xattr_get() with `if (!rc && ...)`, but dt_xattr_get() returns the xattr byte count (>0) on success, so those branches never run. That leaves only the la_flags path working, and defeats the ldo_parent_encrypted detection that the create-a-file-under-an-encrypted-dir case depends on.

commit.subject: LU-10026 csdc: prohibit set compression upon encrypted file
commit.message:
LU-10026 csdc: prohibit set compression upon encrypted file

Setting compression layout component upon encrypted file is not
allowed for now.

This patch add this check on MDS in creating file with layout,
adding/merging new mirror to existing file.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity-sec env=ONLY=67,PTLDEBUG=-1
Signed-off-by: Bobi Jam <bobijam@whamcloud.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: I60d9f4bfce3a498f1eb3994c6276afb9d89c99a7
